The user pointed out, correctly, that the SH2 remake renders its title/attract sequence in-engine; with ZERO input sent by the probe and none evidenced, the simplest account is that the game idled at its title sequence and the closure was harmless. The durable lesson survives the correction in sharper form: at close time the probe COULD NOT DISTINGUISH menu-idle from human-play — it lacked the one check that answers it (recent-input query, e.g. GetLastInputInfo, plus foreground history). Provenance ('I launched it') plus a lifecycle action minus that check is a gamble that happened to be safe here. Recorded in agent-returns with the correction trail.
